summary:
Comprehensive frontend e2e testing of Zoom-services clone completed using Playwright against the public preview URL. 17/17 critical flows passed: login render, eye-toggle, wrong-password error rendering (no React crash), successful login -> /dashboard redirect, TopBar (Z ZOOM logo, amber usage pill 'Usage: 114/15000', green 'Add custom names', logout, indigo 'Classic UI'), three dashboard sections + Create Task panel, full Create Task flow (meeting 123456789, members 5, floating-emoji toggle ON via aria-pressed, timeout 30 -> 'Task started' toast + row visible in All Meetings), stop active task, schedule task ~2min in future + appears in Scheduled Tasks, cancel scheduled, switch to /classic (uppercase 'Download Detail's' button visible) and back to /dashboard via 'New UI', /file-editor render (Div File Editor header, sidebar Files, action buttons, info banner, textarea with placeholder), New File via window.prompt dialog, save 'Alice
Bob

Charlie' -> sidebar count updates to 3 (empty line stripped), Rename via rename-input + rename-save, name-source dropdown contains Indian+English builtins+custom file (after fetch resolves), Delete file via confirm dialog, Logout -> /login, and unauthenticated /dashboard correctly redirects to /login.

issues: Initial render shows only the seeded default 'Indian' until /api/name-files/builtin and /api/name-files responses resolve (~200-500ms). Minor flash-of-incomplete-options. Could be mitigated by waiting for both fetches before first render or showing a loading skeleton. Did NOT cause any functional failure during testing.

loadOptions() swallows fetch errors with empty `catch {}`. If the request fails (e.g., 401 race on first paint right after login redirect), the dropdown silently stays at default ['Indian'] with no retry. Recommend adding a retry on 401 or surfacing a toast. Note: in all 2 retests after a stabilising 2.5s wait, both builtin pools appeared correctly.

action_items: Optional UX polish: show a loading state in the Name dropdown until both /name-files/builtin and /name-files responses are received (currently briefly shows only 'Indian').

Optional resilience: surface a toast or retry in CreateTaskPanel.loadOptions() instead of silently swallowing errors with empty catch blocks (this also applies to several other catch {} sites in DashboardPage and ClassicDashboardPage).
critical_code_review_comments: Multiple silent empty catch blocks across DashboardPage.jsx, ClassicDashboardPage.jsx, FileEditorPage.jsx, CreateTaskPanel.jsx and AuthContext.js (e.g. `} catch {}` on load() and `} catch {}` on refreshMe). Errors are swallowed with no toast/log/retry — makes debugging hard and lets transient 401s silently leave UI in default state.

CreateTaskPanel useState seeds nameOptions with only [{id:'Indian'}] before the actual builtin pools come back from the server, which briefly hides 'English'. Either start with []+loading state, or seed with both [Indian, English].
FileEditorPage uses window.prompt and window.confirm — works, but not styled. Consider a custom modal for consistency with the dark theme.

DashboardPage and ClassicDashboardPage duplicate ~80% of their logic (load/cancel/download/bulkDelete/del + table rendering). Extract a shared hook (e.g., useTasks(date)) and table primitives to avoid drift.
App calls refreshMe() inside load() every 6s — fine, but it means /api/auth/me is polled twice as much as needed. Consider refreshing /me only on usage changes or user-initiated actions.
Good: extensive data-testid coverage on every interactive/info element makes the app very automatable.
Good: Login form properly handles error state via setError and the error div uses data-testid='login-error' for testability.
Good: PrivateRoute correctly redirects unauthenticated /dashboard visits to /login (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (17/17 flows passed; one initial flake on dropdown was confirmed to be a test-timing issue, not a product bug)

seed_data_creation: Test created 1 task (123456789, 5 members) -> cancelled; 1 scheduled task (987654321, 3 members) -> cancelled; 1 custom name-file 'TestNames_<ts>' with content 'Alice/Bob/Charlie' -> renamed -> deleted. Net change to DB: none beyond usage counter increments from cancelled tasks (which the backend intentionally does not decrement, per iteration_1 note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical UI flows confirmed working end-to-end against the public preview URL with the seeded admin. data-testid coverage is excellent. The only non-blocking observation is the brief 'Indian only' state of the Create Task name dropdown right after Dashboard mount before /name-files responses resolve; allow ~1-2s wait before asserting dropdown contents in future scripts. Use page.on('dialog', ...) for window.prompt (new file) and window.confirm (delete file). For toast assertions use `page.wait_for_selector('text=...')` quickly — sonner toasts auto-dismiss.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues found. The one initial 'dropdown only has Indian' failure during the long e2e run was reproduced as a timing issue: CreateTaskPanel renders synchronously with default state {Indian} then fetches builtin+custom pools async. When the assertion ran <500ms after the dashboard remount on Back navigation, fetches were still in-flight. After a 2.5s settle, options correctly become ['Indian','English'(+'custom files')].
